items.title: AWS Marketplace helps humans and agents buy, deploy, and transact
items.summary: In this post, we introduce new AWS Marketplace capabilities launching at re:Invent 2026 that reduce friction across the buying journey—AI agents that can purchase products billed to your existing AWS account, a new data as a service category, smarter discovery and conversational checkout through agent mode, built-in GRC review, automated deployment, and approvals that reach the right people.
items.creator: Mya Papolu
